scene: You step off the maglev dragon train into glowing Dragon Lantern Market.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a stone market floor. Far left, the sleek maglev dragon train rests with open doors. Left, a vendor steams tall bamboo dumpling baskets. The player in red bomber jacket and roller skates stands left-centre. Centre, a brass teapot-pouring robot balances cups. Far right, an open circular neon moon gate glows brightly.
shown: a towering bamboo steamer cart wafting steam, situated on the left
a brass four-armed robot balancing porcelain teapots, standing at the centre
a glowing red circular moon gate entrance on the far right
